The chance that a vowel is one of a pair is the sum of their percentages, which must exceed 34. Every pair with E (45) qualifies: AE, EI, EO, EU, that is 4. Among the rest only A + I = 20 + 15 = 35 exceeds 34 (A + U = 32, I + U = 27 and the others are smaller). So there are 5 pairs.
The three least frequent vowels are O (8), U (12) and I (15), totalling 35. The most frequent of them is I, whose share is 15/35 = 3/7 = 42 6/7 %.
O and U together are 8 + 12 = 20% of all vowels, so 20% = 5040 and the total is 25200. E is 45% of that: 0.45 x 25200 = 11340.
